complexity_target.silhouette_rule: Every major form must read at three levels: primary mass, secondary breakup, and micro-detail accents.
complexity_target.pixel_budget_rule: When a highlight, barb, seam, relic, or notch is added, reclaim equivalent mass through adjacent negative-space shaving instead of expanding total silhouette bulk.
complexity_target.line_definition_rule: Contour cuts happen beside the readable line, shape, or curve, never through its clean outer read.
complexity_target.review_goal: Rendered review boards must prove high-detail density while remaining believable for later DMG slicing.

translation_rules: Author environment as 32x32 metatiles with epic silhouettes and depth bands, then slice each block into sixteen 8x8 DMG tiles.
Author characters on a 32x32 canvas, but keep the readable body mass inside the central 16x16 core.
Reserve the remaining 16x16 envelope for weapon arcs, spell trails, cape flare, and hit telegraphs.
Armor and tool pieces are independent draggable layers keyed to named anchor points on every animation frame.
Balance added detail with removed pixels so downsampled DMG exports keep their contour logic and value separation.
Favor cathedral-grotesque asymmetry, apotropaic guardian posing, and beast-human hybrid breakup over flat decorative noise.
Export runtime sheets as DMG-safe 8x8 and 8x16 chunks while preserving the higher-level 32x32 authoring guides for art review.
pixel_economy_principles: Trade flat fill for contour notches, seam breaks, shadow pockets, and selective cutaways rather than growing the silhouette.
When a horn gains a ring, ridge, or barb, shave an adjacent membrane, cheek, or interior highlight so the total read stays disciplined.
Use negative space around jawlines, rib cages, relic chains, and claw gaps to preserve curves without over-thickening forms.
Micro-detail clusters belong at the narrative focal points: face, throat, hands, relics, telegraph edges, and shrine glyphs.

medieval: Cathedral gargoyles and grotesques as apotropaic guardians perched above danger.
Dragon-throated river monsters with elongated mouths and necks that project outward like spouts.
Bestiary hybrids blending goat, lion, carrion bird, hound, and bat traits into a single readable silhouette.
Vice-marking objects such as bells, chains, censers, reliquary cages, and spoiled prayer ribbons.
gothic: Ribbed arches, tracery breaks, pointed canopies, and ruin silhouettes that imply sacred architecture gone feral.
Mask-like corbels, hidden faces, exaggerated mouths, and weather-darkened stone ornament.
Soot streaks, cracked shrine ornament, and vertical spine rhythms that echo nave ribs and flying buttresses.

style_direction.player: anime-chibi survivor proportions, fully clothed, oversized eyes, clean silhouette, readable tool posing, and restrained apotropaic trim at collar, belt, and hems
style_direction.daemons: medieval and gothic folkloric hybrids with gargoyle throats, horn crowns, spine ridges, vice relics, and dramatic asymmetry that still reads at DMG scale
style_direction.environment: broad cinematic scope, layered horizons, shrine ruins, broken tracery, wreckage, and dune depth in every biome
style_direction.combat: telegraphed and choreographed attack arcs that read clearly before contact and feel carved into the surrounding negative space
